name: vulnvote
title: vulnvote
blurb: reddit for vulnerabilities, on atproto: look up any CVE or GHSA, vote it up or down by how bad it really is, and rate its severity 0-10. aliases collapse to one canonical entry, votes live in each voter's own PDS, and every vote is weighted by account age, vouches from other voters and how close their severity calls land to consensus. asked for by @agnoster.net.
